extracted.intended_audience: researchers, students, policymakers, and general readers seeking country factbook-style country profiles and statistics
extracted.subtask_description: Structured country profile entries listing geographic, demographic, economic, communications, transportation, military, government, and transnational-issues data (CIA World Factbook-style). Each metric is presented as a labeled data field with occasional explanatory notes and year/estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative historical and political background describing origins, major historical events, colonial history, independence, and important recent developments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Often a paragraph summarizing key historical and political context (e.g., establishment as a territory, independence dates, major ruling families, strategic significance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Location
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic description of where the country/territory is located (region, nearby seas, relative position to other landmasses).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short phrase (e.g., 'Southeastern Asia, bordering the South China Sea and Malaysia').

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic coordinates
rubrics_metrics.description: Latitude and longitude coordinates given in degrees and minutes (e.g., '4 30 N, 114 40 E').

rubrics_metrics.name: Map references
rubrics_metrics.description: References to maps or map regions relevant to the country (e.g., 'Southeast Asia', 'Central America and the Caribbean').

rubrics_metrics.name: Area
rubrics_metrics.description: Area statistics including total area and explicit water/land breakdown (e.g., 'total: 5,770 sq km; water: 500 sq km; land: 5,270 sq km').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include a 'note' clarifying inclusions (e.g., 'note: includes the entire Chagos Archipelago').

rubrics_metrics.name: Area - comparative
rubrics_metrics.description: A comparative statement putting area in context with a familiar reference (e.g., 'slightly smaller than Delaware').

rubrics_metrics.name: Land boundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of land boundaries and bordering countries (e.g., 'total: 381 km; border countries: Malaysia 381 km').

rubrics_metrics.name: Coastline
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of the country's coastline in kilometers (e.g., '161 km').

rubrics_metrics.name: Maritime claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims such as territorial sea, contiguous zone, exclusive economic zone, or exclusive fishing zone (e.g., 'territorial sea: 12 nm; exclusive economic zone: 200 nm').

rubrics_metrics.name: Climate
rubrics_metrics.description: General climate description (e.g., 'tropical; hot, humid, rainy' or 'temperate; cold, damp winters; hot, dry summers').

rubrics_metrics.name: Terrain
rubrics_metrics.description: Short description of terrain features (e.g., 'flat coastal plain rises to mountains', 'mostly mountains with lowlands in north and southeast').

rubrics_metrics.name: Elevation extremes
rubrics_metrics.description: Lowest and highest point elevations (e.g., 'lowest point: Indian Ocean 0 m; highest point: Bukit Pagon 1,850 m').

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural resources
rubrics_metrics.description: List of notable natural resources (e.g., 'petroleum, natural gas, timber', 'coconuts, fish, sugarcane').

rubrics_metrics.name: Land use
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent breakdown of land use categories (e.g., 'arable land: 0.57%; permanent crops: 0.76%; other: 98.67% (2001)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Irrigated land
rubrics_metrics.description: Area of irrigated land in sq km with year of estimate (e.g., '10 sq km (1998 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural hazards
rubrics_metrics.description: List of natural hazards relevant to the country (e.g., 'hurricanes and tropical storms (July to October)', 'earthquakes, landslides').

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - current issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Notable environmental problems or issues (e.g., 'air pollution from industrial emissions; rivers polluted from raw sewage, heavy metals...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - international agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: International environmental agreements to which the country is a party or has signed (e.g., 'party to: Climate Change-Kyoto Protocol, Endangered Species...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include 'signed, but not ratified' lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - note
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional geographic notes explaining strategic location or special circumstances (e.g., 'archipelago of 2,300 islands; Diego Garcia...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Population
rubrics_metrics.description: Total population estimate with date (e.g., '365,251 (July 2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Age structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of population by age groups with male/female counts where available (e.g., '0-14 years: 29.1% (male 54,243; female 52,013)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Median age
rubrics_metrics.description: Median age overall and by sex with year of estimate (e.g., 'total: 26.7 years; male: 27.3 years; female: 26 years (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Population growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual population growth rate with year of estimate (e.g., '1.95% (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Birth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Crude birth rate per 1,000 population with year of estimate (e.g., '19.33 births/1,000 population (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Death rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Crude death rate per 1,000 population with year of estimate (e.g., '3.4 deaths/1,000 population (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Net migration rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Net migration per 1,000 population with year of estimate (e.g., '3.59 migrant(s)/1,000 population (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Sex ratio
rubrics_metrics.description: Sex ratio figures for various cohorts (at birth, under 15, 15-64, 65+, total) (e.g., 'at birth: 1.06 male(s)/female').

rubrics_metrics.name: Infant mortality rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Infant mortality per 1,000 live births by total and sometimes by sex with year of estimate (e.g., 'total: 13.05 deaths/1,000 live births (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Life expectancy at birth
rubrics_metrics.description: Life expectancy at birth overall and by sex with year of estimate (e.g., 'total population: 74.54 years; male: 72.13 years; female: 77.09 years (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Total fertility rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Average number of children born per woman with year of estimate (e.g., '2.33 children born/woman (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS - adult prevalence rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated adult HIV/AIDS prevalence rate (e.g., 'less than 0.1% (2003 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS - people living with HIV/AIDS
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated number of people living with HIV/AIDS with year of estimate (e.g., 'less than 200 (2003 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS - deaths
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated deaths attributable to HIV/AIDS with year of estimate (e.g., 'less than 200 (2003 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Nationality
rubrics_metrics.description: Noun and adjective forms used for the country's nationals (e.g., 'noun: Bruneian(s); adjective: Bruneian').

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethnic groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of ethnic composition with percentages (e.g., 'Malay 67%, Chinese 15%, indigenous 6%, other 12%').

rubrics_metrics.name: Religions
rubrics_metrics.description: Religious composition and percentages (e.g., 'Muslim (official) 67%, Buddhist 13%...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Official and commonly used languages (e.g., 'Malay (official), English, Chinese').

rubrics_metrics.name: Literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition used and literacy rate(s) by sex and total with year (e.g., 'definition: age 15 and over can read and write; total population: 93.9%').

rubrics_metrics.name: Country name
rubrics_metrics.description: Conventional long form, short form, and abbreviation (e.g., 'conventional long form: Negara Brunei Darussalam; conventional short form: Brunei; abbreviation: BND' — note: currency code example shows structure in another field).

rubrics_metrics.name: Dependency status
rubrics_metrics.description: Political status such as 'overseas territory of the UK', 'constitutional sultanate', etc., and notes on administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government type
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal description of the country's system of government (e.g., 'constitutional sultanate', 'internal self-governing').

rubrics_metrics.name: Capital
rubrics_metrics.description: Name of the capital city (e.g., 'Bandar Seri Begawan', 'Road Town').

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Subnational units and names/number (e.g., '4 districts ... Belait, Brunei and Muara, Temburong, Tutong').

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence
rubrics_metrics.description: Date of independence or relevant sovereignty change (e.g., '1 January 1984 (from UK)').

rubrics_metrics.name: National holiday
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary national holiday and date (e.g., 'National Day, 23 February (1984)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Constitution
rubrics_metrics.description: Date or notes on the constitution and any unusual statuses (e.g., '29 September 1959 (some provisions suspended under a State of Emergency since December 1962)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal system
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of the legal system and any parallel systems (e.g., 'based on English common law; for Muslims, Islamic Shari'a law supersedes civil law in a number of areas').

rubrics_metrics.name: Suffrage
rubrics_metrics.description: Voting age and suffrage notes or 'none' where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Details on chief of state, head of government, appointment/election methods, and cabinet arrangements (e.g., 'chief of state: Sultan and Prime Minister Sir HASSANAL Bolkiah (since 5 October 1967)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include notes on how officials are selected and dates in office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legislative branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Structure of the legislature (unicameral/bicameral), number of seats, election method and term lengths (e.g., 'unicameral Legislative Council (13 seats; members are elected by direct popular vote...)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of the court system and key courts (e.g., 'Supreme Court (chief justice and judges are sworn in by the monarch for three-year terms)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Political parties and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: List of named political parties and their leaders when provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political pressure groups and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Named pressure groups and leaders or 'NA' if none.

rubrics_metrics.name: International organization participation
rubrics_metrics.description: List of international organizations the country participates in (e.g., 'APEC, ARF, ASEAN, UN, WTO...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation in the US
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on the country's diplomatic representation in the United States (e.g., 'chief of mission: Ambassador ... telephone: ... chancery: address').

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation from the US
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on the US diplomatic presence in the country (e.g., 'chief of mission: Ambassador Gene B. CHRISTY; embassy: Third Floor, Teck Guan Plaza...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag description
rubrics_metrics.description: Textual description of the national flag (colors, symbols, arrangement).

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - overview
rubrics_metrics.description: Short narrative overview of the economy, major sectors, resource dependence, welfare measures, and policy concerns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Often a paragraph highlighting dominant industries (e.g., oil and gas), per capita wealth, and economic plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP
rubrics_metrics.description: Gross Domestic Product measured at purchasing power parity with year (e.g., '$6.5 billion (2002 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - real growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Real GDP growth rate with year of estimate (e.g., '3% (2002 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - per capita
rubrics_metrics.description: GDP per capita at purchasing power parity with year (e.g., '$18,600 (2002 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - composition by sector
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent contribution of agriculture, industry, and services to GDP (e.g., 'agriculture: 5%; industry: 45%; services: 50% (2001 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Population below poverty line
rubrics_metrics.description: Share or presence/absence of data on population below poverty line with year if provided (often 'NA').

rubrics_metrics.name: Household income or consumption by percentage share
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution of household income or consumption by percentiles (e.g., lowest 10%, highest 10% — often 'NA').

rubrics_metrics.name: Inflation rate (consumer prices)
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual inflation rate for consumer prices with year of estimate (e.g., '-2% (2002 est.)', '2.5% (2002)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor force
rubrics_metrics.description: Size of labor force with year and any notes about composition (e.g., '143,400; note: includes foreign workers and military personnel; temporary residents make up about 40%').

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor force - by occupation
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent breakdown of labor force across sectors (e.g., 'agriculture, forestry, and fishing 10%; production of oil, natural gas, services, and construction 42%; government 48% (1999 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Unemployment rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Unemployment percentage with year of estimate (e.g., '10% (2001)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Government budget totals: revenues and expenditures with year and notes on capital expenditures (e.g., 'revenues: $2.5 billion; expenditures: $2.6 billion, including capital expenditures of $1.35 billion (1997 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Agriculture - products
rubrics_metrics.description: Main agricultural products and commodities (e.g., 'rice, vegetables, fruits, chickens, water buffalo').

rubrics_metrics.name: Industries
rubrics_metrics.description: Key industries and industrial outputs (e.g., 'petroleum, petroleum refining, liquefied natural gas, construction').

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial production growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual growth rate of industrial production with year (e.g., '5% (2002 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Electricity - production
rubrics_metrics.description: Electricity production in kWh with year of estimate (e.g., '2.497 billion kWh (2001)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Electricity - consumption
rubrics_metrics.description: Electricity consumption in kWh with year of estimate (e.g., '2.322 billion kWh (2001)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Electricity - exports
rubrics_metrics.description: Electricity exports in kWh (often '0 kWh'), with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electricity - imports
rubrics_metrics.description: Electricity imports in kWh (often '0 kWh'), with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oil - production
rubrics_metrics.description: Oil production in barrels per day with year of estimate (e.g., '217,200 bbl/day (2001 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Oil - consumption
rubrics_metrics.description: Oil consumption in barrels per day with year of estimate (e.g., '13,000 bbl/day (2001 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Oil - exports
rubrics_metrics.description: Oil export figures or 'NA' with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oil - imports
rubrics_metrics.description: Oil import figures or 'NA' with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oil - proved reserves
rubrics_metrics.description: Proved oil reserves with date (e.g., '1.255 billion bbl (1 January 2002)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural gas - production
rubrics_metrics.description: Natural gas production in cubic meters with year of estimate (e.g., '10.35 billion cu m (2001 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural gas - consumption
rubrics_metrics.description: Natural gas consumption in cubic meters with year of estimate (e.g., '1.35 billion cu m (2001 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural gas - exports
rubrics_metrics.description: Natural gas exports in cubic meters with year of estimate (e.g., '9 billion cu m (2001 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural gas - imports
rubrics_metrics.description: Natural gas import figures (often '0 cu m') with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural gas - proved reserves
rubrics_metrics.description: Proved natural gas reserves with date (e.g., '315 billion cu m (1 January 2002)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports
rubrics_metrics.description: Total export value (f.o.b.) with year of estimate (e.g., '$3.439 billion f.o.b. (2002 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports - commodities
rubrics_metrics.description: List of major export commodities (e.g., 'crude oil, natural gas, refined products').

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports - partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Main export partner countries and percentages where available (e.g., 'Japan 41%, South Korea 11.2%...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Imports
rubrics_metrics.description: Total import value with year of estimate (e.g., '$1.63 billion c.i.f. (2002 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Imports - commodities
rubrics_metrics.description: List of main imported commodities (e.g., 'machinery and transport equipment, manufactured goods, food, chemicals').

rubrics_metrics.name: Imports - partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Main import partner countries and percentages where available (e.g., 'Singapore 19.9%, Malaysia 19.8%...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Debt - external
rubrics_metrics.description: External debt totals with year of estimate (e.g., '$0', '$36.1 million (1997)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Economic aid - recipient
rubrics_metrics.description: Amount of economic aid received with year of estimate (e.g., '$4.3 million (1995)', 'NA').

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency
rubrics_metrics.description: Name of the national currency (e.g., 'Bruneian dollar (BND)', 'US dollar (USD)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency code
rubrics_metrics.description: Three-letter currency code (e.g., 'BND', 'USD').

rubrics_metrics.name: Exchange rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Recent exchange rates to the US dollar with years (e.g., 'Bruneian dollars per US dollar - 1.7422 (2003), 1.7906 (2002)...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Often given as series over several years and may include notes about currency arrangements (e.g., use of US dollar).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fiscal year
rubrics_metrics.description: Country fiscal year period (e.g., 'calendar year', '1 April - 31 March').

rubrics_metrics.name: Telephones - main lines in use
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of main telephone lines in use with year of estimate (e.g., '90,000 (2002)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Telephones - mobile cellular
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of mobile cellular subscriptions with year of estimate (e.g., '137,000 (2002)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Telephone system
rubrics_metrics.description: General assessment and descriptions of domestic and international telephone infrastructure (e.g., 'general assessment: service throughout the country is excellent; domestic: every service available; international: country code - 673; satellite earth stations - 2 Intelsat...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Radio broadcast stations
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of AM, FM, and shortwave radio broadcast stations with year (e.g., 'AM 3, FM 10, shortwave 0 (1998)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Radios
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated number of radios in use with year (e.g., '329,000 (1998)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Television broadcast stations
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of television broadcast stations with year of estimate (e.g., '2 (1997)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Televisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated number of televisions in use with year of estimate (e.g., '201,900 (1998)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet country code
rubrics_metrics.description: Internet top-level country code (e.g., '.bn', '.br', '.vg', '.io').

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet hosts
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of internet hosts with year of estimate (e.g., '6,409 (2003)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet Service Providers (ISPs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of ISPs operating with year of estimate (e.g., '2 (2000)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet users
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated number of internet users with year (e.g., '35,000 (2002)', '14.3 million (2002)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Railways
rubrics_metrics.description: Total railway length and electrified length with gauge breakdown where provided (e.g., 'total: 29,412 km (1,610 km electrified)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include detailed gauge categories (broad, standard, narrow, dual gauge) and electrification lengths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Highways
rubrics_metrics.description: Total highway length and paved vs unpaved breakdown with year (e.g., 'total: 1,724,929 km; paved: 94,871 km; unpaved: 1,630,058 km (2000)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Waterways
rubrics_metrics.description: Total navigable waterways length with notes on usage and location (e.g., '50,000 km (most in areas remote from industry and population) (2004)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Pipelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Lengths of various pipeline types (e.g., 'condensate/gas 244 km; gas 10,739 km; oil 5,212 km; refined products 4,755 km (2004)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Ports and harbors
rubrics_metrics.description: Major ports and harbors by name (e.g., 'Belem, Fortaleza, Manaus, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador, Santos...').

rubrics_metrics.name: Merchant marine
rubrics_metrics.description: Total merchant fleet and types and gross register tonnage/dwt breakdown (e.g., 'total: 151 ships (1,000 GRT or over) 2,961,431 GRT/4,725,267 DWT; by type: bulk 29, cargo 22...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May list foreign-owned and registered-in-other-countries counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Airports
rubrics_metrics.description: Total number of airports with year of estimate (e.g., '3,803 (2003 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Airports - with paved runways
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of airports with paved runways and breakdown by runway length categories (e.g., 'total: 698; over 3,047 m: 7; 2,438 to 3,047 m: 23; 1,524 to 2,437 m: 158; 914 to 1,523 m: 461; under 914 m: 49 (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Airports - with unpaved runways
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of airports with unpaved runways and breakdown by runway length categories (e.g., 'total: 3,438; 914 to 1,523 m: 1,579; under 914 m: 1,780 (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Heliports
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of heliports with year of estimate (e.g., '417 (2003 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Military branches
rubrics_metrics.description: List of military service branches (e.g., 'Brazilian Army, Brazilian Navy (including Naval Air and Marines), Brazilian Air Force (FAB)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower - military age and obligation
rubrics_metrics.description: Compulsory and voluntary service ages and obligation periods where applicable (e.g., '19 years of age for compulsory military service, conscript service obligation - 12 months; 17 years of age for voluntary service (2001)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower - availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated number of males of a given age range available for military service (e.g., 'males age 15-49: 52,100,042 (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower - fit for military service
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated number of males fit for military service in the given age range (e.g., 'males age 15-49: 34,799,098 (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower - reaching military age annually
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of males reaching military age annually (e.g., 'males: 1,788,495 (2004 est.)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Military expenditures - dollar figure
rubrics_metrics.description: Military spending in US dollars with year of estimate (e.g., '$10,439.4 million (2003)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Military expenditures - percent of GDP
rubrics_metrics.description: Military spending as a percent of GDP with year of estimate (e.g., '2.1% (2003)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational Issues - Disputes - international
rubrics_metrics.description: Descriptions of international disputes, boundary issues, claims by other states, or contested territories (e.g., disputes over Chagos Archipelago, Uruguay islands, or seabed rights).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include details about repatriation, leases, or legal rulings affecting status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational Issues - Illicit drugs
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary of illicit drug production, transshipment, trafficking, and law-enforcement issues (e.g., 'illicit producer of cannabis; minor coca cultivation; upsurge in drug-related violence and weapons smuggling').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include notes on money laundering and transnational criminal activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: This page was last updated on
rubrics_metrics.description: Date the profile page was last updated (e.g., '10 February, 2005').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides staleness/context for the estimates and figures used throughout the profile.
